The topic of Quality Indicator Definition outlines the specific metrics used to evaluate and monitor the standard of care for patients with atrial fibrillation in Denmark. These indicators are established as part of the clinical quality monitoring efforts associated with [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] and the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] [^src1]. By defining precise numerators, denominators, and clinical events, these indicators ensure that healthcare providers can accurately track treatment adherence, patient outcomes, and educational interventions.

The defined indicators cover a comprehensive range of clinical and patient-centered outcomes. For instance, Indicator 4a tracks the proportion of eligible patients receiving anticoagulation therapy, with strict definitions for prescription redemptions around the 1-, 2-, and 5-year anniversaries of their diagnosis [^src1]. Indicator 4b focuses on the safety monitoring of patients on direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) by measuring the proportion who receive at least one annual P-creatinine test [^src1]. 

Beyond treatment adherence, the indicators also monitor severe adverse events and patient education. Indicators 5, 6, and 7 measure the incidence of ischemic stroke, intracranial hemorrhage, and major bleeding (using adapted ISTH criteria), respectively, among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. Finally, Indicator 8 evaluates the patient experience and empowerment by measuring the proportion of newly diagnosed patients who participate in a structured educational program within one year of their diagnosis [^src1]. Together, these definitions form a robust framework for assessing the quality of atrial fibrillation care across the Danish healthcare system.

## Claims

- Indikator 4a måler andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, med indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling, der modtager behandling (ud af den population hvor det er indiceret) [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)
  Type: quality-indicator-definition
  Page: 106
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 106-110
- For indikator 4a er tælleren patienter i nævneren, som modtager behandling, dvs. der er indløst mindst én recept i perioden 90 dage før til 90 dage efter 1, 2 og 5-års dagen for diagnosedatoen for atrieflimren [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)
  Type: quality-indicator-definition
  Page: 106
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 106-110
- Indikator 4b måler andelen af patienter med atrieflimren i behandling med direkte orale antikoagulantia (DOAC) med mindst 1 måling af P-creatinin årligt [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)
  Type: quality-indicator-definition
  Page: 106
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 106-110
- Indikator 5 måler incidens af iskæmisk apopleksi blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)
  Type: quality-indicator-definition
  Page: 107
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 106-110
- Indikator 6 måler incidens af intrakraniel blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)
  Type: quality-indicator-definition
  Page: 107
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 106-110
- Indikator 7 måler incidens af alvorlig blødning (tillempede International Society of Thrombosis and Hemostasis (ISTH) kriterier) blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)
  Type: quality-indicator-definition
  Page: 107
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 106-110
- Indikator 8 måler andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren som får et struktureret undervisningsprogram indenfor 1 år efter diagnosen er stillet [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram)
  Type: quality-indicator-definition
  Page: 109
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 106-110
